title: The reply was lost: retry the intention, not a new one
goal: Handle redelivery and same-requestIDpayload conflicts without duplicate documents.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P10. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: The sender does not know the result, but the receiver may already have saved a document. Assigning a new key turns a retry into another operation. Trace the key, payload and result reference.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Own copy, common module and separate caller
paragraphs: Continue your own training copy after P10. Preserve a DT backup and previous sources, restore into a separate new infobase and verify its path. Preserve prior work and records.

Put functions in server common module УчебныйОбмен: Server/Server call enabled, Client, Global, Privileged disabled. Данные.bsl and Приложение.bsl belong to different modules. Append only missing definitions and retain one copy of each helper.
Preserve the previous application handler first. Remove only the added startup call after one experiment. Your UUIDs and own process port may differ from the author’s observation.

sections.title: Delivery can repeat
paragraphs: A sender may miss the reply to an accepted request. Redelivery with the samerequestIDshould return the agreed result without another document. This differs from deduplicating similar names. Define the key’s sender/operation scope and retention policy.

Create an own operation with a fresh UUID key and 30 minutes. Store the key in the existing Comment field of a new synthetic request; it is not an account ID or an instruction to clear data. Repeats compare minutes/customer/service, not only key labels.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныйОбмен common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The first own UUID key with 30 minutes creates a request. An exact retry returns the same reference. The same key with 31 minutes conflicts, while an independent key query finds one 30-minute effect. The helper’s two preparation requests belong to another set.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Bind key to content
paragraphs: Store requestID, canonical payload semantics or hash, state and result reference. The sameIDwith different amounts is a conflict, not permission to overwrite the first request. Different JSON key order can have identical semantics; define hashing rules explicitly.

First reception creates a record, an equal repeat returns the same reference and a 31-minute conflict rolls back. An independent key query must find exactly one 30-minute effect. A transaction alone does not prove uniqueness for two concurrent first requests.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: The same key arrives with different minutes. Should the prior result be overwritten?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. A key links one intention to an agreed payload and result. Another payload under that key grants no right to silently replace the document. The check compares minutes, customer and service before saving or returning a result.

sections.title: Acceptance and result are atomic
paragraphs: Processing registry and created document need transactional consistency. MarkingDonebefore a failed write makes retries return a nonexistent result. Writing without registeringIDduplicates on retry. Concurrent repeats need key protection; external effects need a separate protocol.

Run the complete source in a separate own copy through the server module. Print ПовторТотЖе, КонфликтОтклонен, ОдинЭффект and retain the actual key/reference. Two preparation documents form a different set; three documents overall do not mean three operation effects.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The diagram traces one key; the new task compares two intentions. This is an actual sequential experiment. Concurrent first deliveries and crash recovery need separate protection and are not claimed as tested.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: A timeout automatically generates a new UUID. The receiver correctly sees another intention and creates another document. Alternatively, checking only key presence misses a payload conflict. Both differ from an exact retry.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Include unknown outcomes
paragraphs: Test first call, exact retry, payload conflict, mid-step failure and concurrent repeats. After timeout, retry the sameIDand query state. Do not automatically create a newIDfor the same intent. Tie every reply to the original operation and persisted document.

This is a real sequential BSL experiment, not a production receiver. Concurrent receivers need a unique-key register/correct locking, atomic outcome storage and crash recovery. Diagram a lost response: unknown outcome requires state lookup or the same key, not a fresh UUID. These additional guarantees remain unproved.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create an own new customer and service. Accept the first new key with 45 minutes and retry it exactly. A second new key with the same 45 must produce another reference. The first key with 46 must conflict. Querying both keys must find exactly two effects and 90 minutes.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныйОбмен common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: Only the described training paths are established. Real HTTPS services, arbitrary URLs, concurrent first delivery, crash recovery, background queues and scheduling remain NOT RUN. Technical observations, self-report and learner understanding are separate.
Distinguish a retry, new intention, conflict, concurrent first deliveries and crash recovery.

selfcheck.feedback: No. A key links one intention to an agreed payload and result. Another payload under that key grants no right to silently replace the document. The check compares minutes, customer and service before saving or returning a result.
Do not overwrite the first accepted intent.
The key binds retry to the prior operation.
Registry and result need atomic consistency.

selfcheck.prompt: Does a new UUID after an unknown outcome guarantee no duplicates?
options: Yes: key uniqueness removes a prior effect
Yes: a transaction solves all exchange cases
selfcheck.feedback: Distinguish a retry, new intention, conflict, concurrent first deliveries and crash recovery.
